verses.text:
God, don’t keep silent.  
Don’t keep silent,  
and don’t be|strong="H7892"still, God.

For|strong="H8252", behold, your enemies are stirred up.  
Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

Gebal, Ammon, and|strong="H4124"Amalek;  
Philistia with the inhabitants of|strong="H4124"Tyre;

Assyria also is|strong="H6002"joined with|strong="H5973"them|strong="H3427".  
They|strong="H5983"have|strong="H5973"helped the|strong="H5973"children of|strong="H3427"Lot. Selah.

Make their|strong="H1961"nobles like|strong="H1961"Oreb and|strong="H1961"Zeeb,  
yes, all their|strong="H1961"princes like|strong="H1961"Zebah and|strong="H1961"Zalmunna,

My|strong="H3423"God, make them|strong="H3423"like tumbleweed,  
like chaff before the|strong="H3423"wind.

Fill their|strong="H3651"faces with|strong="H3651"confusion,  
that|strong="H3651"they|strong="H3651"may seek your|strong="H7291"name, LORD|strong="H3068".

Let them|strong="H6440"be|strong="H3068"disappointed and|strong="H3068"dismayed forever.  
Yes, let them|strong="H6440"be|strong="H3068"confounded and|strong="H3068"perish;

that|strong="H5704"they|strong="H5704"may know that|strong="H5704"you|strong="H5704"alone, whose name is the|strong="H5704"LORD|strong="H3068",  
are the|strong="H5704"Most High over|strong="H5704"all|strong="H5704"the|strong="H5704"earth.
